runner_dissent: The bull case got marginally better on price: base 5y IRR +4.8%->+6.2%, drawdown -11%->-16.7%, and the 7/28 crash is a crowded-trade correction, not a fundamental break -- the AI-compute bottleneck and CUDA moat are intact (+92% DC, +199% networking, net cash $72B, FCF=OE ~$182B). So why not open a starter into the weakness? I override to WATCH because (a) base IRR is STILL below the 8% hurdle and the price is still +8.8% above the ~$181 buy-below; (b) the price fell for a reason -- the regime (capex audit + visibly scaling custom silicon + Warsh-hawkish discount rates) raises the probability weight on the bear leg, so the cheaper entry is partly compensation for higher risk, not a free discount, and I want MORE margin of safety here, not less; (c) the swing data point -- Q2 FY27 on 2026-08-26 -- hasn't printed, and the market is de-rating into an unconfirmed quarter. Honest posture: closer to a starter than at 06-20, but NOT there yet. A pullback to <=$181 (ideally toward the $164 52wk low) with the thesis intact flips it to STARTER. Existing holders HOLD -- nothing broke.
